text:
ryan: Trying the Go quickstart from the examples repo. First call from my laptop returns 402 even though Console shows promo credits. Only change I made was switching to a service token for CI testing. Any ideas?

mei: Which token exact string? user key vs service token vs workspace-scoped? 402 usually a billing/acceptance gate.

ryan: Using a service token `sk-sa-abc123` mounted via dir /home/runner/.redwood/key, set REDWOOD_API_KEY. Code is literally from examples: `client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "rwd-mini", Input: "hello"})`

onboard-bot: Policy check: token_type=service_account; mapped_workspace=W234; workspace_billing=active; terms_acknowledged=false; admin_email=megan@acme.com

mei: Hmm, console billing active but terms_acknowledged=false for that workspace. We added explicit admin acceptance for service accounts last quarter. Did an admin accept on behalf of W234?

ryan: I thought creating billing automatically accepted everything. The Console's billing page only showed charges/credits, no clear callout about service-token acceptance.

docs-bot: Note: the Console recently introduced a separate banner under Settings > Security for "Service account usage and terms". We should add that to the quickstart README. Filing docs ticket.

mei: Quick debug: run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/workspaces/me` to see which workspace the token maps to. If it's the wrong workspace the admin there might not have accepted terms.

ryan: Ran it — workspace id W234 (yep). Admin on that workspace is different team, they didn't accept the service-account terms.

sdk-go-team: Suggestion for SDKs: surface a clearer error subcode instead of generic `payment_required`. Something like `payment_required:service_terms_unaccepted` and include a `help_url` pointing to the console admin page.

ryan: After admin accepted the terms the same call returned 200 and generated text. Phew. But two asks: 1) docs callout in the Go quickstart about service-account acceptance, and 2) the server error should be actionable (subcode + admin console link).

mei: Filing an ENG-DEVEX ticket to update the quickstart and add an error subcode for this gate. Also adding a short FAQ in the Console billing UI for headless tokens so orgs see the prompt during billing setup.

ryan: One more gotcha I hit — my Dockerfile had REDWOOD_ORG baked in which caused earlier local runs to route to a stale workspace. PRing a line in examples: "Do not bake REDWOOD_ORG into images; set at runtime."

docs-bot: Docs PR reference: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/424 (pending)

ryan: Saved me ~30 minutes. Thanks everyone. Closing thread.
